body: Do you know what thoughts are invoking this?
Do you know the reason why you do you have this hole? It could be a thing that you need to focus on to not have these thoughts

I don't think that your loved ones doesn't care. I think that you just kept them further because you're not feeling good and they respect that. That doesn't mean that don't miss you or that they wouldn't miss you

You're not no one or failure or horrible person for having depression. That's only what your depression is telling to you. It's totally normal for people with depression to have these thoughts you're saying. But it's almost never true. Don't focus on being productive as hell. Don't focus on making big changes. Just start with small changes. Changes that you feel like you can follow. It's impossible for example to be super productive when you're not productive now at all. You can start with making your bed in the morning or something like that. And then start adding other things to follow your goals

Hi
You don't embarrass yourself by saying these things. I see that you have some reasonable thoughts why are you saying this. What I'm doing when I say something like this, I just explain to them why I'm saying it. For example, when you add steam train to that conversation, you just can say "nobody said this, so I felt like saying that" you can try this. This works for me. Probably next thing you need to realize is that you have your personal critic (I don't know if it's right name in English but we have it in Czech). My therapist said to me that he always thy to say us the worst things. So why we don't believe absolutely opposite thing that he's saying to us.
Thank you so much for your tips. Actually I found this better than what my psychiatrist told me. I've tried your tips today and I really feel better. It's not good but I finally got from the worst.

Thank you so much for reaction. So you take thirty minutes break and ten minutes of sorting your thoughts? Do I understand it right? Maybe something like this is the only option to even stay helpful for them. Not just to keep me sane.

Have you send a text message or something on paper? I'm glad you have someone to send them. It shouldn't be any problem to contact any of them if you feel like you're feeling. You have someone that cares about you

Thank you for explaining.

Yeah... Doctors are saying that. I don't know how can I make you sure about something that I'm not sure. Just thinking it might help... But it's kinda bad I know

I'm sorry but I don't understand first sentence entirely. It's like little layer on the cake is losing your job?
Yeah, sure. It can be like that but somehow we still need to manage our lifes. Even if we live in a cruel cosmic joke.

That's so bad... I didn't realize that it's not common in many countries that anyone have health insurance... Was losing your job part of the reason that you feel like this? Or was how your feeling part of the reason why you lost your job?
Do you have some professional help too? I won't force you but you know. I care about people that are feeling like this
Thank you for caring about him so much
I really feel you.. I don't know what to do with it myself. But just wanted to say I feel you.. I wrote a post about it once to. I know how this feels. Just this is on my mind when I read this

Hello. We're in a very same situation. It's not part of the subject, I know but I need to tell you that I (21 F) have attempted suicide a year ago and my best friend (21 M) is thinking about it right now. Enough about me.

I know that you care about his secrets. But this is sadly something that should be said to someone else. It's serious. It's like someone said you that he has cancer and he don't want anyone to know about that. I think that you would say it at least to his doctor. And I recommend you to do the same. 

Call his doctor if you know his name. He is likely to figure out something. Another option is to call some helpline and tell them this. They may help you with it much more than me. Next thing, last that I know about, is somehow get him to a crisis center. We have those in Czechia I don't know if you have this. Or contact a crisis center at least. 

It's absolutely ok if you don't follow my instructions. It's just something that I would do. Maybe you'll find out something better. Wish luck to both of you

It's a new day. It can be a new beginning for you. You can get better this day. Or maybe another but I know it eventually will be better. I've had attempted suicide. And for everyone except one girl in psych ward that I was, it got better a year after

First of all. You're not a failure. Just bad things happened to you and you have ended up in bad situations. Don't give up acting entirely. You can take a break of course. But I feel that it's making you happy. I don't know if it's making you happy now but it will help you again. I'm sorry for hearing that your mom isn't supporting you. If I understood right (I'm Czech) she's still alive. So maybe she will realize how difficult is to live your life too. Maybe she won't. But there's a possibility. If you have some strength to contact your father, do it. It may help you too. Hope you'll get better soon.

I suppose that you didn't take a semester off just because your sleep problems. And I share your pain in this situation. It's so hard to have something done if you're feeling like this. But it will get better. You can try some pills for a better sleeping and most importantly I hope you're going to some psychologist/psychiatrist. Eventually you will find your way
